item.description: 📆 Top News Today ❗️ People's lives first : Residents of the settlement of Aleshki who, during evacuation as part of a humanitarian mission, expressed a desire to leave for Ukraine, have flown from Anapa airport to Gomel airport in the Republic of Belarus. The evacuation is being carried out by military transport aircraft of the Russian Aerospace Forces. 👊 Delivering hard hits: we struck logistics and energy infrastructure facilities and ships used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 Dazzling strike: A Geran-4 UAV team destroyed the AFU P-18 Malakhit radar station. ▫️ Operating confidently: the Tsentr Group's servicemen practiced the evacuation of a wounded comrade from the battlefield. 🎮 Neutralising hostile drones: air cover groups of the Vostok Group of Forces foiled an AFU drone attack in Dnepropetrovsk region. Together we can handle anything! #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ↗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30373

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
↗️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
In Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one motorised infantry brigade, one unmanned systems brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU close to Duvanka, Velikiye Prokhody, Tsupovka, Martovoye, and Velikiy Burluk (Kharkov region).
💥
In addition,
units of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and two territorial defence brigades have been hit near Khoten, Velikaya Rybitsa, Osoyevka, Gnilitsa (Sumy region) and Sumy.
▪️
The enemy lost more than 270 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and eight motor vehicles.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the AFU and two territorial defence brigades close to Monachinovka, Smorodkovka, Glushchenkovo, Studenok (Kharkov region), and Bogorodichnoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 210 servicemen, an armoured fighting vehicle, 21 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and four electronic warfare stations.
📍
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
Strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, one mountain assault brigade of the AFU and one marine brigade near Slavyansk, Kramatorsk, Druzkovka, Vasilyevskaya Pustosh, Semenovka, and Nikolayevka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 190 troops, one armoured personnel carrier, two armoured fighting vehicles, 20 motor vehicles, and one self-propelled artillery gun.
⏩
The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian troops engaged manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and four national guard brigades close to Belozerskoye, Shilovka, Andreyevka, Roganskoye, Starovarvarovka (Donetsk People's Republic), Novopavlovka, and Mezhevaya (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 340 troops, six armoured fighting vehicles, 10 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station.
👉

Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

as of 31 October 2026
Part 2 (

↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
The fire damage was inflicted on manpower and hardware of two assault brigades, one assault brigade, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Sergeyevka, Barvinovka, Vasilevskoye, Tersyanka, and Volnyanka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 190 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, eight motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
They inflicted losses on units of one AFU mountain assault brigade and one territorial defence brigade near Orekhov, Yurkovka, and Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 20 Ukrainian troops and five motor vehicles were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage
on transport infrastructure facilities used by the Armed Forces of Ukraine, storage and launch sites of unmanned aerial vehicles, unmanned ground systems, ammunition depots, temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed groups and foreign mercenaries in 148 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
one guided aerial bomb, four Flamingo long-range cruise missiles, two Neptune long-range guided missiles, and 604 fixed-wing UAVs.
